name: Paneer Power Bowl
description: Smoky paneer, millet and crunchy vegetables with a bright mint-curd dressing.
ingredients: Mint, coriander, lemon and roasted cumin
steps: Whisk curd, mint, coriander, lemon and cumin into a pourable dressing.
Toss paneer and vegetables with oil, salt and chilli; sear on a hot pan for 7-8 minutes.
Layer millet, cucumber and the warm paneer mixture in a bowl.
Finish with the mint-curd dressing and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Moong Chilla Stack
description: Crisp green-moong pancakes layered with herbed paneer for a protein-forward breakfast.
steps: Blend soaked dal with ginger, chilli, cumin, salt and enough water for a thick batter.
Fold spinach and coriander into the batter.
Cook 3 thin chillas on a lightly oiled pan until golden on both sides.
Season paneer with lemon and herbs, then layer between the chillas.

name: Tandoori Chicken Plate
description: Juicy spiced chicken with jeera rice, kachumber and cooling coriander yogurt.
steps: Coat chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, spices, lemon and salt; rest for at least 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear for 6-8 minutes per side until cooked through.
Mix chopped cucumber, tomato and onion with lemon for kachumber.
Serve chicken with jeera rice, salad and coriander yogurt.

name: Tofu Bhurji Wrap
description: Turmeric tofu scramble, peppers and fresh chutney rolled into a soft whole-wheat roti.
steps: Crumble tofu and pat away excess moisture.
Saute onion and capsicum in oil, then add tomato and spices.
Fold in tofu and cook for 5 minutes; finish with lemon and coriander.
Spread chutney on warm rotis, fill with bhurji and roll tightly.

name: Rajma Quinoa Bowl
description: Comforting rajma over fluffy quinoa with a crisp lime slaw and roasted seeds.
steps: Saute onion, ginger and garlic; add tomato and rajma masala until jammy.
Add beans and a splash of water; simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss cabbage and carrot with lime, coriander and salt.
Serve rajma over quinoa with slaw and mixed seeds.

name: Egg Masala Toast
description: Creamy masala eggs on seeded toast with a refreshing tomato-cucumber side.
steps: Whisk eggs with turmeric, pepper and salt.
Saute onion, chilli and tomato in ghee until soft.
Add eggs and stir gently until just set.
Pile onto toasted bread and serve with lemony cucumber.

name: Lentil Coconut Curry
description: A fragrant red-lentil curry with spinach, light coconut milk and brown rice.
steps: Saute ginger, garlic and spices for 30 seconds.
Add tomato, lentils and coconut milk; simmer for 12 minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted and season with lime.
Serve with brown rice and coriander.

name: Lean Chicken Keema Bowl
description: Spiced lean chicken mince, peas and cauliflower rice with a warm whole-wheat phulka.
steps: Brown chicken mince in a hot pan, breaking it into small pieces.
Add onion, ginger, garlic, tomato and spices; cook until fragrant.
Fold in peas with a splash of water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve with cauliflower rice, phulka, coriander and lemon.

name: Fruit & Yogurt Crunch
description: Thick yogurt, seasonal fruit, toasted oats and seeds for a fast, satisfying start.
steps: Toast oats in a dry pan with cinnamon for 3-4 minutes.
Spoon yogurt into a bowl and top with chopped fruit.
Add toasted oats and seeds.
Drizzle with honey only if extra sweetness is needed.

name: Palak Chana Plate
description: Creamy spinach chickpeas with jowar roti and a crunchy onion-lemon salad.
ingredients: Cumin, coriander powder and garam masala
steps: Blanch spinach briefly, cool and blend until smooth.
Saute onion, ginger and garlic in oil; add tomato and spices.
Stir in chickpeas and spinach puree, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve with jowar rotis and onion-lemon salad.

name: Coconut Fish Tikka
description: Lime-coconut fish tikka with sauteed beans and a small portion of red rice.
steps: Coat fish in coconut milk, lime, ginger, chilli, turmeric and salt.
Rest for 10 minutes, then grill or pan-sear until opaque and flaky.
Saute green beans with cumin and a splash of water.
Plate fish with beans and red rice; finish with lime.

name: Peanut Sattu Smoothie
description: A creamy banana, sattu and peanut smoothie built for busy training mornings.
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend for 45 seconds until completely smooth.
Add water or ice to adjust thickness.
Drink soon after preparing.

name: Besan Vegetable Chilla
description: Golden chickpea-flour pancakes packed with colourful vegetables and served with fresh coriander chutney.
steps: Whisk besan, spices, salt and enough water into a smooth, pourable batter.
Fold the spinach, carrot, capsicum and coriander through the batter.
Spread three thin chillas on a lightly oiled hot pan and cook both sides until golden and set.
Blend coriander, lemon, chilli and a splash of water for chutney, then serve alongside.

name: Banana Cocoa Chia Pudding
description: Creamy cocoa chia pudding with banana, sattu and cacao nibs for a make-ahead, fibre-rich snack.
steps: Mash half the banana in a bowl, then whisk in coconut milk, sattu, cocoa and cinnamon until smooth.
Stir in chia seeds, wait 5 minutes, then stir again so they do not clump.
Cover and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight until thick.
Top with the remaining sliced banana, cacao nibs and optional berries before eating.
